description:
Job Description: Data Consumer Analyst (Data Lineage & Migration) Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Data Consumer Analyst to support a strategic migration from an on-premises data warehouse to a modern AWS S3-based cloud data platform. In this role, you will be responsible for discovering, documenting, and analyzing all data consumers, dependencies, reports, applications, and business processes that rely on the existing data ecosystem. You will work closely with business stakeholders, BI teams, data engineers, architects, and application owners to ensure a seamless migration with minimal business disruption. Key Responsibilities Identify and inventory all consumers of enterprise data, including reports, dashboards, applications, interfaces, data feeds, and business teams. Perform end-to-end data lineage analysis and document data flow from source systems through transformations to consumption layers. Analyze database objects, ETL processes, reporting assets, and downstream dependencies to understand migration impacts. Review query logs, access patterns, and usage metrics to distinguish active data assets from obsolete or redundant ones. Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to validate data dependencies and usage requirements. Create and maintain detailed dependency maps, consumer catalogs, migration inventories, and risk assessments. Support migration planning by identifying critical business processes and potential risks prior to cutover. Develop automation scripts and tools to accelerate data discovery, lineage tracking, and dependency analysis. Assist engineering teams in prioritizing migration waves based on business criticality and complexity. Ensure accurate documentation and knowledge transfer throughout the migration lifecycle. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in Data Warehousing, Data Analytics, Data Governance, or Data Migration projects. Strong understanding of Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, ETL/ELT processes, and enterprise data architecture. Advanced SQL skills with experience analyzing complex datasets, queries, and database dependencies. Experience working with both Relational Databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) and NoSQL databases. Hands-on programming experience in Python for automation, scripting, and data analysis. Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS, with exposure to Amazon S3. Experience performing impact analysis, dependency mapping, and data lineage documentation. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to interact across technical and business teams. Proven experience supporting large-scale data migration or modernization initiatives. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Data Governance and Metadata Management tools such as Collibra, Alation, Informatica EDC, Apache Atlas, or AWS Glue Data Catalog. Hands-on experience with BI and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Knowledge of AWS data services and cloud-native analytics platforms. Experience building automation solutions, AI agents, or intelligent workflow tools. AWS Certifications such as: AWS Certified Data Engineer AWS Certified Solutions Architect AWS Certified Data Analytics Key Skills Data Lineage Data Mapping Impact Analysis Dependency Analysis Data Migration Data Warehouse Data Lake AWS S3 SQL Python Data Governance Metadata Management Data Catalog ETL / ELT Business Intelligence Power BI Tableau RDBMS NoSQL Stakeholder Management Cloud Migration Data Discovery Automation

description:
HCP-Level & Commercial Analytics
o

o

o
Analyze market dynamics around the brand — competitive uptake, payer mix shifts, channel mix, and launch trajectory benchmarking against analog launches.
3.
Brand Performance Reporting & Diagnostics
o
Own the brand performance reporting layer for the Insights & Analytics team — weekly and monthly trackers, KPI dashboards, and the diagnostic deep-dives that explain what the trackers are showing.
o
Establish reporting SLAs, refresh calendars, validation checkpoints, and exception protocols. Every number that reaches the client should be traceable and defensible.
4.
Methodology & Data Management
o
Be the methodology owner for the analyses you lead — selection of approach, defensible documentation, peer review, and post-delivery learning capture.
o
Work fluently with the secondary data stack used on the account: IQVIA (Xponent, DDD, NPA), Komodo, Symphony, specialty pharmacy and hub data, payer/claims data, and Veeva CRM.
o
Read and challenge BRDs, source-to-target mappings, and business rule definitions critically. Catch issues upstream — in the spec — rather than in the dashboard. Experience o
5–8 years in pharma / life sciences analytics, with experience spanning both patient-level and HCP-level / commercial analytics for US biopharma clients.
o
Direct, hands-on experience at one of: ZS Associates, Axtria, IQVIA, Trinity, Cognizant Life Sciences, or an in-house Insights & Analytics team at a top-25 pharma company.
o
Demonstrated work on a launch or early in-line brand is strongly preferred; specialty therapy exposure (HIV/PrEP, oncology, rare disease, immunology) is a plus.
o
Comfortable operating alongside other analytics vendors on the same account — you will not be the only analytics partner in the room.
2.
Domain Expertise (US Pharma Commercial)
o
Working knowledge of patient journey analytics: cohort construction, persistence and adherence measurement, bridging logic, switching analysis, and the data limitations of each.
o
Working knowledge of HCP-level analytics: prescribing dynamics, market share decomposition, segmentation diagnostics, and promotion response measurement.
o
Fluency with the secondary data stack: IQVIA Xponent / DDD / NPA, Symphony, Komodo, specialty pharmacy and hub data, payer/claims data, and Veeva CRM.
o
Understanding of the launch analytics rhythm — what questions the brand team asks pre-launch, in early launch, and through steady state.
3.
Technical Skills
o
Strong SQL — complex joins, window functions, and performance-tuned queries on large healthcare datasets.
o
Python for analysis and modeling: pandas, scikit-learn, stats models; comfort building and validating models (regression, classification, survival, response-curve fitting).
o
Sound grounding in relational and dimensional data modeling — enough to read a BRD or mapping document critically, not necessarily to build the warehouse.
o
Proficiency in at least one BI platform (Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik) sufficient to design and review dashboards, not just author them.
o
Comfortable instituting QC discipline: writing validation scripts, designing reconciliation routines, and documenting business rules.
4.
Consulting & Communication
o
Able to lead a client conversation, not just present in one: frame the problem, walk through methodology, defend the recommendation, and adjust based on pushback.
o
Writes cleanly — methodology notes, BRDs, executive summaries, and slide narratives that hold up to scrutiny.
o
Comfortable disagreeing with a senior client constructively, and equally comfortable saying "we don't know yet, here is how we'll find out."

description:
ABOUT ELEVANCE HEALTH Elevance Health is a leading health company in America dedicated to improving lives and communities and making healthcare simpler. ABOUT CARELON GLOBAL SOLUTIONS Carelon Global Solutions (CGS) is a healthcare solutions company simplifying complex operational processes to improve the health of the healthcare system. 
 Previously known as Legato Health Technologies, Carelon Global Solutions (hereinafter, CGS) underwent a name change and joined the Carelon family of brands in January 2023, as a fully owned subsidiary of Elevance Health (Previously Anthem Inc.). CGS brings together a global team of like-minded innovators who manage and optimize operational processes for health plans as well as providers. 
 Our brightest minds housed across our global headquarters in Indianapolis as well as Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Gurugram in India, Manila in the Philippines, and San Juan in Puerto Rico bring with them innovative capabilities and an unmatched depth of experience. This global team uniquely positions CGS to enable scalable, next-generation platforms and specialized digital tools that make healthcare operations more practical, effective, and efficient. OUR MISSION & VALUES Our Mission: Improving Lives and Communities. Simplifying Healthcare. Expecting More.
 Our Values: Leadership | Community | Integrity | Agility | Diversity 
 JOB PURPOSE 
 We are seeking a highly analytical and business-oriented Data Analyst with strong reporting and data analysis capabilities. The ideal candidate should be able to analyze large datasets, identify trends and patterns, perform root cause analysis, and provide actionable recommendations to support business decisions. The role requires expertise in SQL, reporting tools, data visualization, and the ability to translate data into meaningful insights for stakeholders. 
 JOB RESPONSIBILITY 
 Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and business opportunities. Gather, understand, and translate business requirements into analytical solutions. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs using reporting and visualization tools. Perform exploratory data analysis and root cause analysis to address business challenges. Generate actionable insights and recommend data-driven solutions to improve business performance. Collaborate with business stakeholders to define metrics and success criteria. Create recurring and ad-hoc reports to support operational and strategic decision-making. Monitor data quality and ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness of reporting outputs. Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. Support process improvement initiatives through data analysis and performance measurement. 
 EXPERIENCE 
 4+ years of experience in Data Analysis, Business Analytics, or Reporting roles. Strong hands-on experience with SQL and relational databases. Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker. Experience analyzing large datasets and deriving business insights. Ability to work directly with stakeholders and understand business processes. Experience working in Healthcare, Insurance, Banking, Retail, or Enterprise Data environments is preferred. 
 SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES 
 Technical Skills 
 Advanced SQL with strong knowledge of joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions, and query optimization. Strong experience in Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools. Data modeling and reporting experience. Knowledge of data warehousing concepts. Exposure to Python, Snowflake, or cloud platforms is an advantage. 
 Analytical & Business Skills 
 Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills. Ability to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities from data. Expertise in root cause analysis and problem-solving. Ability to convert findings into actionable business recommendations. Strong understanding of KPI development and performance measurement. 
 Communication Skills 
 Excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills. Ability to communicate analytical findings to leadership and business users. Strong documentation and reporting capabilities. 
 Primary Skills 
 SQL Data Analysis Business Analysis Reporting & Dashboarding Power BI / Tableau Stakeholder Management 
 Preferred Skills 
 Snowflake Python Data Warehousing Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure) Healthcare or Insurance Domain Experience 
 Ideal Candidate Profile 
 The ideal candidate should be someone who: 
 Can independently analyze data and identify business patterns. Thinks analytically and applies logical reasoning to solve problems. Recommends solutions and improvement opportunities based on data findings. Builds impactful dashboards and reports for business stakeholders. title: Senior Analyst - Credit Operations
description:
Senior Analyst - Credit Operations 
 Responsibilities 
Own weekly reporting on the borrower funnel: Application Completion Rate, Offer Acceptance Rate, TAT, and stage-level drop-off. Root-cause funnel bottlenecks from registration to disbursal and propose fixes with sized impact. Own retention and repeat-borrower analysis: cohort trends, churn drivers, early-warning signals. Design and run retention tests, and report results against a stated baseline. Analyse collections performance - recovery rate by DPD bucket, in-house vs agency allocation, agent-level productivity - and hand the collections team ranked priorities. Run reconciliations across disbursements, repayments, and fund movements, clearing discrepancies with IT. Track tele-sales, support, and voicebot performance against target: FRT, CSAT, conversion throughput. Build and maintain the reporting and automation layer - SQL, dashboards, AI tooling - that turns raw data into decision-ready recommendations. 
 6-12 Month Expectations 
 Registration-to-Disbursal conversion improved by 5 percentage points, off the drop-off diagnostic that drove it. Month-on-month repeat-borrower retention held at 15% every month and reaching 20% by month 12, off a documented cohort and churn analysis. Reconciliation and the tele-sales readout (FRT, CSAT, conversion) running as standing processes, with zero unexplained discrepancies and zero SLA breaches. 
 Who We Are Looking For 
 3-5 years in business operations, product, or web/app analytics within digital consumer lending or a high-growth fintech. Hands-on SQL plus Python or Apps Script: writes and runs own queries against raw tables, builds automations with no dependency on an engineer. Advanced daily use of AI tools: drafting and stress-testing queries, running automations, building dashboards and readable reports. Broke down an ambiguous operational problem against large, messy data and defended the recommendation to the people who had to act on it. Written SOPs and process notes that a team then ran on. Working knowledge of the Indian digital lending ecosystem and core credit concepts: DPD buckets, disbursal flow, repayment and collection mechanics. Track record of switching between analysis and hands-on execution - this is not an advisory role. Fluent in English.

 Senior Associate, Business Analysis
   

  

 At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and relational databases—cutting\-edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward to today, and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

 Today, we are a high\-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one, impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder\-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry, and each other.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate at Capital One, you will apply your analytical skills to major company challenges. You'll team with world\-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact how the company manages customer friction and resolution. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.
   

  

**Team Description**
 Welcome to Customer Navigator. We are the central nervous system for enterprise\-wide customer resolution, serving as the one\-stop engine to resolve complaints across all Capital One Lines of Business (LOBs).
   

  

 We are not just improving processes; we are completely re\-engineering how we understand and resolve customer friction. Our platform aggregates massive amounts of fragmented enterprise data, mapping it into a seamless, chronological "journey format" for our agents. By layering advanced Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning over this data within an easily understandable User Interface (UI), we empower our teams to resolve complex customer issues with unprecedented speed, empathy, and accuracy.
   

  

**Role Description**
 General responsibilities include but are not limited to:
   

  

* Bridge Business and Data: Partner with cross\-functional teams (Tech, Lines of Business, Product) to translate complex data requirements into actionable product features for the Customer Navigator platform.
* Analytical Problem Solving: Support the business strategy by analyzing data to identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI for predicting, understanding, and resolving complaints before they escalate.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a liaison between business users and the product team; gather feedback, understand processes, uncover opportunities to improve decision\-making, and drive continuous improvement in workflows.
* Data Translation: Interpret and translate complex analytical outputs into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that inform complaint resolution strategies.
* Communication: Communicate technical concepts and research results effectively to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and non\-specialist colleagues, through structured presentations and storytelling.
* Execution Focus: Display an intense focus on achieving both short\- and long\-term goals, helping drive business intent and product adoption in an uncertain and fluid environment.


**The ideal candidate is:**
* Inquisitive: You thrive on solving big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea.
* Technical: You’re comfortable navigating complex analytical solutions and have hands\-on experience conducting business analyses using modern data tools.
* Innovative: You continually are on the lookout for novel approaches, solutions, and emerging technologies (like GenAI) to solve business problems and improve the customer experience.


**Basic Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economics, Econometrics, Finance or Operations Research).
* At least 2 years of professional work experience in analytics, business analysis or data\-driven product management.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* 3\+ years of experience with Python, R, SQL and relational databases.
* Experience in the financial services industry, specifically dealing with cross\-LOB operations, customer experience or complaint resolution.
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy, and proficiency in key econometric and statistical techniques (such as hypothesis testing, regression modeling, etc.).
* Experience translating ambiguous business problems into clear analytical questions and tangible product features.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

We combine the scale and complexity of enterprise banking projects with the ownership, speed and learning opportunities of a growing technology company . 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced Core Banking Business Analyst / Techno-Functional Consultant who can work directly with banking customers and delivery teams to drive Core Banking implementations and customization engagements. This is not a documentation-only Business Analyst role . The candidate should be capable of understanding banking requirements, conducting customer workshops, preparing functional specifications, proposing solutions, working with technical teams on customizations and driving requirements through testing, go-live and post-production support. The role requires strong banking functional knowledge along with sufficient technical understanding to discuss areas such as batch processing, schedulers, EOD/BOD, interfaces, APIs, database/data flows and integrations . The role involves direct interaction with international banking customers and may require international travel for workshops, implementations, UAT, training, cutover and go-live activities . 
 Key Responsibilities Conduct discovery sessions and functional workshops with banking customers to understand business processes, requirements, gaps and regulatory needs. Analyze customer requirements and prepare functional documentation including: Functional Specification Documents Business Requirement Documents Use Cases / User Stories Process Flows Gap Analysis Functional Solution Documents Understand the bank's requirements and recommend appropriate solutions using standard Core Banking functionality, configuration or customization . Independently drive functional discussions with customers and translate business requirements into implementable solutions. Work closely with architects, developers and technical consultants to define solutions for Core Banking customizations. Evaluate customization requirements from both a functional and high-level technical perspective and assess the impact on existing Core Banking processes. Understand and discuss technical areas relevant to Core Banking implementations including: Batch processes EOD/BOD processing Job schedulers Interfaces and APIs Integration flows Database and data flows File-based interfaces Logs and error handling Upstream and downstream systems Deep programming expertise is not expected; however, the candidate should be comfortable discussing solution approaches with technical teams and understanding the technical impact of functional requirements. Possess strong functional knowledge across multiple Core Banking areas such as: Customer / CIF CASA Deposits Lending Teller Operations Payments Forex Fees and Charges Interest Processing Back-office Operations Accounting / General Ledger Interfaces Work with development teams to clarify functional requirements and ensure that customizations meet the intended business requirement. Review proposed solutions and ensure alignment between customer requirements, product functionality and technical implementation. Support product configuration, customization and integration activities throughout the implementation lifecycle. Prepare functional test scenarios and participate in: Functional Testing System Integration Testing User Acceptance Testing Regression Testing Analyze defects and production issues and identify whether the issue is related to product functionality, configuration, customization, integration or data. Prioritize and triage implementation and production issues based on business impact and criticality. Support data migration validation, reconciliation and cutover activities from a functional perspective. Conduct product demonstrations, functional walkthroughs, Train-the-Trainer sessions and end-user training. Participate in go-live planning, cutover, production readiness and implementation activities. Provide functional support during go-live, stabilization and post-production support . Liaise with bank stakeholders, project managers, architects, development teams, QA teams, product teams and third-party vendors. title: Senior Data Mapping Analyst, Servicing Transaction Management
description:
Position Summary: 
 The Servicing Transaction Management department is responsible for the loan boarding and deboarding process. This role relates to converting other servicers data to upload into Onitys loan servicing system and subsequently validating the data uploaded versus the data and/or documents received for all newly boarded loans. This position is responsible for developing projects in the loan boarding and related applications for bulk and flow transfers. The Data Mapping Analyst will analyze and program boarding files, as well as participate in data mapping, researching issues and testing the application and data loads. This position requires strong analytical skills and technical knowledge to support the Loansphere Loan Boarding System (LLB) as well as the Onity proprietary Loan Boarding Tool. The Data Analyst will work closely with various parties including their immediate team, business units, prior servicers and other technical teams to coordinate data transformation. This role will also be responsible for implementing tools to support transfer efficiency, as well as keeping documentation updated and communicating changes to processes, procedures and tools. 
 JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 Ensures that new loan programs or changes are incorporated into the boarding process. Analyzes boarding error messages to determine root cause and remediates issues. Creates edit checks within the Loan Baording System to recognize errors prior to boarding. Develop and configure the Loan Boarding System, as well as supporting toolsets such as SharePoint to support boarding data management. This includes mapping of seller/prior servicer data, create and update tables and define and implement solutions for converting the data. Perform testing to support trials and production. Review error reports and document/communicate issues found. Determine solutions for issues. Define requirements for and implement tools and processes to improve data quality and visibility. Work closely via meetings and conference calls with Business Unit Leads and prior servicers to ensure data transformation is accurate and clearly communicated. Update/create procedures and continue to enhance and optimize the boarding process, including tool enhancements as required. Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements (i.e. RESPA, USAP, Sarbox, etc.). Produce and review required control reporting. Meet all established milestones for deboarding/boarding project plans. Follow all established procedures regarding boarding/deboarding. Ensure all quality steps are completed and documented. Escalate any possible deadline misses. Communicate boarding/deboarding expectations with internal and external clients regularly. Organize meetings with internal and external clients with documented meeting minutes. Self-driven, should be able to handle high pressure. Must identify ways to automate processes and set up controls when required. Willing to work extra hours as per the process requirements/Flexibility to work in accordance with Business requirements. 
 KEY RESULTS AREA: 
 Reduce number of Servicing Transaction Management related customer complaints by a designated management percentage year over year. Maintain quality at 100%. Meet all milestones related to the loan boarding process. Timely responses to servicers and internal parties. 
 QUALIFICATIONS: 
 This position requires a significant amount of mortgage servicing knowledge, including but not limited to, the ability to identify and understand various data points utilized within loan servicing systems to successfully service loans and interpret mortgage loan collateral and loan servicing documentation used in conjunction with the data to service loans. Experience with different loan programs such as ARM’s, HELOC’s, buydowns, Commercial, etc. Bachelor’s Degree preferred, or minimum of five (5) + years’ mortgage servicing experience. SQL experience preferred Minimum of 4 years’ experience working with LoanSphere Loan Boarding (LLB). MSP servicing system experience required. Advanced PC skills: Microsoft applications, including Excel and Access Database, Monarch, Adobe, SharePoint and LoanSphere Loan Boarding (LLB). Ability to deal with complex difficult problems involving multiple facets and variables in non-standardized situations. Ability to set up controls and being able to speak to auditors/QA teams regarding process Ability to identify inconsistencies or issues in data and help come up with solutions Set up organized structure for incoming mapping changes and tracking for all internal and external partners. Ability to work independently, meet established deadlines, be very detail orientated, and have excellent organizational skills. Organizational skillset able to handle multiple transactions at the same time Ability to easily adapt to changes in processes, procedures and priorities. Proven strength in interpreting business requirements and implementing them in application or operational tools. Ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external clients to determine requirements Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience with Empower or Encompass origination system a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and attention to detail and accuracy.

Key Skills: Dashboards,Python,Dax Queries,Business Intelligence,Bex Reporting,BI Tools,Business Intelligence Reporting,Power BI Reports

title: Intrusion Analyst III
description:
Position Summary... What youll do... Job Summary As a SOC Analyst, you will monitor, detect, analyze, investigate, and support remediation of cybersecurity events in accordance with established standard operating procedures. You will combine hands-on security operations expertise with data-driven investigation, automation, and responsible use of AI/Generative AI to improve analyst effectiveness, detection quality, investigation consistency, and response outcomes. The role requires close collaboration with stakeholders, engineering teams, incident responders, and business units across a global operating environment. About the Team The Information Security organization helps protect Walmart s customers, associates, information assets, and technology environment. SOC Incident Management is a centralized security operations function responsible for monitoring, detecting, analyzing, investigating, escalating, and responding to security threats. Analysts work alongside security engineers, incident responders, threat intelligence teams, and other cybersecurity professionals to protect the organization s information assets and networks. Key Responsibilities Security Monitoring, Investigation Incident Response Monitor, triage, analyze, investigate, and support remediation of cyber events using defined SOC procedures, playbooks, escalation paths, and service expectations. Perform investigation across endpoint, network, email, identity, cloud, Windows, and Linux telemetry; correlate evidence across multiple data sources to determine scope, impact, root cause, and recommended actions. Run approved commands, queries, scripts, and automation for assigned areas of work while maintaining appropriate operational controls and documentation. Identify indicators of compromise, suspicious behaviors, attack patterns, and emerging risks; escalate confirmed or high-risk incidents to the appropriate response teams. Communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders during troubleshooting and security events, providing timely status, findings, risk context, and recommended next steps. Detection Engineering Continuous Improvement Provide actionable input to improve alert logic, correlation rules, detection use cases, thresholds, enrichment, prioritization, and suppression of known false positives. Identify opportunities for new risk detection based on investigation trends, threat intelligence, recurring incidents, control gaps, and observed attacker behavior. Partner with engineering and platform teams to validate and operationalize detection improvements across SIEM, EDR, SOAR, email security, firewall, IPS, and cloud security tooling. Capture investigation learnings, recurring patterns, root causes, and operational gaps; recommend measurable improvements to SOC processes, playbooks, documentation, and analyst workflows. AI / Generative AI Responsibilities Use approved AI/GenAI capabilities (for example, Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, or enterprise-approved equivalents) to assist with investigation summarization, evidence correlation, query/script drafting, threat-context synthesis, case documentation, and recommendation generation. Critically validate AI-generated analysis against authoritative telemetry and security evidence before using it for incident decisions, escalation, remediation, or stakeholder communication. Maintain analyst accountability for final conclusions. Assess the quality of AI-assisted investigations by identifying inaccurate conclusions, missed evidence, weak reasoning, hallucinations, incomplete recommendations, or inconsistent outputs, and provide structured feedback for improvement. Help develop and refine prompts, analyst workflows, evaluation criteria, test cases, and feedback loops that improve the accuracy, consistency, explainability, and operational usefulness of AI-assisted SOC analysis. Identify appropriate opportunities to integrate AI/GenAI with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence, case-management, and knowledge-management workflows to reduce repetitive analyst effort and accelerate triage and investigation. Apply responsible-AI and security principles when using AI tools, including data handling, confidentiality, access controls, human oversight, traceability, and compliance with company policies and approved-use requirements. Monitor AI-assisted workflows for quality and operational risk, and escalate cases where AI output could create false assurance, inappropriate remediation, data exposure, or other security impact. Contribute to AI readiness across the SOC by documenting effective practices, sharing lessons learned, and supporting analyst adoption and training for approved AI-enabled capabilities. Cybersecurity Technology Solution Support Support cybersecurity intelligence and security-operations solutions by gathering requirements, researching technologies, participating in solution reviews, and contributing to supplier/product evaluations. Develop and review system, process, investigation, and operational documentation to support consistent execution and knowledge transfer. Maintain current knowledge of cybersecurity threats, attacker techniques, security technologies, automation, and AI/GenAI developments relevant to SOC operations. Collaboration, Documentation Stakeholder Management Participate in team assignments and projects, provide timely progress updates, contribute to team meetings and technical discussions, and support cross-functional initiatives. Create and review high-quality case notes, standard operating procedures, playbooks, knowledge articles, metrics, reports, and presentations for management, technical teams, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders. Build collaborative relationships across functional and organizational boundaries and respond effectively to stakeholder and business-unit requests. Governance, Ethics Compliance Operate in accordance with company policies, security standards, procedures, ethical expectations, and applicable compliance requirements. Protect sensitive information throughout investigations and communications, using approved systems and appropriate data-handling practices. Demonstrate professional judgment, fact-based decision-making, transparency, and appropriate escalation when evidence is incomplete or risk is uncertain. Required Experience Technical Skills B.E./B.Tech/M.S./M.Tech/MCA or equivalent technical qualification, with approximately 4-6 years of relevant SOC/cybersecurity operations experience. Hands-on experience with EDR and SIEM technologies across on-premises and cloud environments; Azure Sentinel/Microsoft Sentinel and Google Chronicle experience is desirable. Experience with SOAR, email security, incident/case management, firewall, IPS, security correlation, detection use-case development, and deployment. Hands-on cybersecurity investigation skills including malware analysis, phishing/email analysis, network and endpoint investigation, and Windows/Linux operating-system analysis. Practical exposure to AI/GenAI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, and Gemini, with the ability to use them responsibly and critically in cybersecurity workflows. Ability to develop or adapt security queries, scripts, and automation to support investigation and operational efficiency. Experience working with global teams and flexibility to work rotational shifts as business needs require. Core Competencies Professional Judgment: Researches and integrates relevant information and evidence, applies fact-based criteria, looks beyond symptoms, identifies root causes, and makes defensible recommendations. Execution Results: Prioritizes effectively, uses established tools and processes, manages time and operational challenges, and delivers against business and security objectives. Planning Continuous Improvement: Develops practical improvement plans, anticipates potential problems, and identifies opportunities to streamline processes and improve SOC performance. Influence Communication: Communicates technical findings and risk clearly, proactively shares timely updates, listens actively, and prepares effective documentation and presentations. Relationship Building: Builds trusting, collaborative relationships across teams, organizational levels, and diverse backgrounds. Customer/Member Focus: Understands stakeholder needs and uses data, analysis, and insights to improve service and security outcomes. Ethics Compliance: Models ethical conduct, follows policies and procedures, protects sensitive information, and supports compliance expectations. Adaptability Learning: Adapts to changing priorities, embraces new responsibilities and technologies, and continuously updates and shares knowledge. Analytical Problem Solving: Demonstrates strong investigation, reasoning, decision-making, and problem-solving skills in complex and fast-moving situations. Preferred Qualifications Industry certifications such as CIH, CompTIA Security+/CySA+ or related CompTIA certifications, CEH, or other relevant cybersecurity certifications. Experience improving SOC processes through automation, detection engineering, analytics, or AI-assisted investigation workflows. Demonstrated interest in emerging technology and a track record of taking ownership in a fast-paced, results-driven environment. About Walmart Global Tech

title: Sr Business Analyst, MDM Operations
description:
Job Description About Vantive Vantive is a vital organ therapy company dedicated to extending lives and expanding possibilities for patients and care teams around the world. As Vantive continues to establish and optimize its independent operating model, master data serves as a critical business asset that supports operational excellence, regulatory compliance, supply chain effectiveness, financial processes, customer experience, and enterprise decision-making. Within Global Shared Services / Finance, the Master Data Management (MDM) organization is responsible for delivering high-quality, governed master data that enables the business to operate effectively across global markets and functions. Position Summary The Senior Business Analyst, Master Data Management Operations is responsible for the day-to-day execution and delivery of MDM operational services across multiple master data domains. This role serves as a front-line operational resource, supporting business users, investigating and resolving data-related incidents, fulfilling work requests, maintaining data quality, and ensuring service commitments are met. The successful candidate will partner closely with business stakeholders, data stewards, MDM operations teams, IT support teams, and external partners to ensure timely and accurate execution of master data processes. The role requires strong analytical skills, problem-solving capabilities, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently to identify and resolve issues. This position is ideal for a hands-on MDM professional who enjoys operational execution, customer support, troubleshooting, process improvement, and managing data within a complex global environment. What You'll Be Doing MDM Operational Service Delivery Execute day-to-day master data operations activities across Item, Supplier, Finance, Customer, and other supported master data domains. Service work orders, requests, and transactions in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs), operational procedures, and data governance standards. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents within defined SLAs while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations. Analyze and resolve master data issues independently, escalating only when necessary and providing clear documentation of findings and corrective actions. Perform root cause analysis on recurring issues and partner with stakeholders to implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions. Monitor work queues, backlog volumes, and service levels to ensure timely completion of requests and adherence to operational targets. Data Quality & Governance Execute data validation, cleansing, enrichment, and maintenance activities to support master data accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Ensure compliance with established master data standards, business rules, governance policies, and control requirements. Identify data quality issues, exceptions, and process breakdowns and partner with data stewards to drive resolution. Support execution of data quality monitoring and remediation activities across assigned master data domains. Participate in audits, compliance reviews, and control activities as required. Business Support & Stakeholder Engagement Serve as a primary point of contact for business users requiring support related to master data processes, requests, incidents, and inquiries. Partner with stakeholders across Finance, Supply Chain, Commercial, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Shared Services to understand issues and deliver effective solutions. Communicate issue status, resolution plans, and service updates in a professional and customer-focused manner. Support business process changes, organizational initiatives, and operational improvements impacting master data management processes. Continuous Improvement & Analytics Identify opportunities to streamline processes, reduce manual effort, improve cycle times, and enhance service delivery performance. Support development and maintenance of operational KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting. Utilize data and operational metrics to identify trends, recurring issues, capacity constraints, and improvement opportunities. Assist with testing, validation, training, and deployment activities associated with MDM enhancements and projects. Maintain and update standard operating procedures, work instructions, process documentation, and knowledge management materials. Project Support Participate in MDM projects, system enhancements, process improvement initiatives, and data migration activities. Execute assigned project tasks including testing, data validation, business process documentation, issue tracking, and deployment support. Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure successful implementation of solutions that support operational objectives. What You'll Bring Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Information Systems, Data Management, Engineering, or related field. 4-7 years of experience in Master Data Management, Shared Services, Business Operations, Data Governance, Supply Chain Operations, Finance Operations, or related disciplines. Experience working within an operational support environment with defined SLAs and service delivery expectations. Proven experience servicing work requests, investigating incidents, troubleshooting issues, and resolving operational problems independently. Strong understanding of master data concepts, including data governance, data quality, hierarchy management, workflows, standards, and controls. Experience working with MDM and ERP platforms such as Syndigo/Riversand, SAP, SAP MDM/ MDG, JD Edwards, Oracle, or comparable enterprise systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues and determine root causes. Experience developing and executing testing scenarios, validation activities, and process documentation. Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced operational environment. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting Item Master, Supplier Master, Customer Master, Finance Master Data, or Product Information Management processes. Experience using SQL, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools for data analysis and reporting. Experience supporting global organizations and working within matrix environments. Healthcare, medical device, manufacturing, life sciences, or regulated industry experience. Experience working with Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies. English proficiency required; additional language capabilities are a plus. Success in This Role Success in this role will be measured through: Consistent achievement of SLA commitments and service delivery targets. Quality and accuracy of master data transactions and work order execution. Timely resolution of incidents and reduction of recurring issues. Improvements in data quality, operational efficiency, and stakeholder satisfaction. Effective participation in MDM projects and continuous improvement initiatives. Ability to operate independently while maintaining strong collaboration with business and technology partners.
